preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: (('water' in input.lower() or 'wet' in input.lower() or 'wash' in input.lower()) and ('i don''t know' in input.lower() or 'slime' in input.lower())) -> return_value == 'sludge'
postconditions.description: If the input contains any form of 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' and any form of 'I don''t know' or 'slime', the output must be 'sludge'.

postconditions.expression: ('water' in input.lower() or 'wet' in input.lower() or 'wash' in input.lower()) and not ('i don''t know' in input.lower() or 'slime' in input.lower()) -> return_value == 'water'
postconditions.description: If the input contains any form of 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' but does not contain any form of 'I don''t know' or 'slime', the output must be 'water'.

postconditions.expression: not ('water' in input.lower() or 'wet' in input.lower() or 'wash' in input.lower()) and ('i don''t know' in input.lower() or 'slime' in input.lower()) -> return_value == 'slime'
postconditions.description: If the input does not contain any form of 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' but contains any form of 'I don''t know' or 'slime', the output must be 'slime'.

postconditions.expression: not ('water' in input.lower() or 'wet' in input.lower() or 'wash' in input.lower()) and not ('i don''t know' in input.lower() or 'slime' in input.lower()) -> return_value == 'air'
postconditions.description: If the input does not contain any form of 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' and does not contain any form of 'I don''t know' or 'slime', the output must be 'air'.
